title: BCCI to Honour Roger Binny, Rahul Dravid and Mithali Raj with Lifetime Achievement Awards at Naman Awards 2026 - BCCI
description: Find out how legendary cricketers will be honored with lifetime achievement awards at the upcoming Naman Awards.
content:
A striking image of Roger Binny, Rahul Dravid, and Mithali Raj dressed in traditional Indian attire, awaiting their recognition with a sense of pride and excitement.

Background

The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) has announced plans to honor three legendary cricketers at the upcoming Naman Awards 2026. The esteemed players—Roger Binny, Rahul Dravid, and Mithali Raj—are set to receive Lifetime Achievement awards during this prestigious event.

#### Key Developments

The announcement was made via a series of official communications across various media platforms including Google News, ESPNcricinfo, Cricbuzz.com, and The Times of India. Here’s an overview of the players being honored:

1. Roger Binny: Known for his versatility as both a batsman and wicketkeeper, Binny has been one of India's most trusted leaders in the field. 2. Rahul Dravid: Often hailed as "The One," Dravid's career spanned over two decades with a blend of cricketing skill and managerial acumen.

3. Mithali Raj: The 'Iron Lady' of Indian women's cricket, Raj is celebrated for her technical skills and leadership qualities in the domestic and international arena.

These three legends have made significant contributions to the sport of cricket and are being recognized for their enduring impact on the game.

#### Industry Impact

The honor of receiving such a prestigious award not only recognizes these players' achievements but also reinforces the importance of legacy in cricket. It underscores how their skills, commitment, and dedication continue to influence players around the world today.

##### Expert Perspective A senior cricketer from India’s cricketing elite shared his thoughts on this significant event:

> "It is a moment that we have all been eagerly waiting for. This award will not only recognize our hard work but also inspire the next generation of Indian cricketers." Dravid added, "I am very proud to be honored with such an accolade, and I believe it will motivate many young players."

#### What This Means

For these individuals, this recognition comes at a time when they are facing their twilight in cricketing careers. It serves as a celebration of their achievements that go beyond the playing field. For fans, it’s a chance to relive their memories and pay tribute to the legends.

##### Looking Ahead The Naman Awards 2026 is set to bring together a diverse group of talents from across various sports disciplines. This recognition for these three athletes adds another layer of excitement to what promises to be an excellent event.

With tickets already selling out quickly, fans can expect to see many cricketers and other sportspersons competing at this year’s Naman Awards 2026. The legacy being built with the Lifetime Achievement awards is sure to shine through on the grand stage of sportsmanship.
